title: Artificial Intelligence based Models for Screening of Hematologic Malignancies using Cell Population Data.
summary: ANN classification of routine cell-population data separated malignant and nonmalignant cases in one retrospective cohort; authors limit use to screening support, not diagnosis.
ai_technology: An artificial neural network classifies malignant and non-malignant cases from routine cell-population data.
organization: Graduate Institute of Biomedical Informatics, Taipei Medical University, Taipei, Taiwan

evidence.tested: ANN classification of routine cell-population data separated malignant and nonmalignant cases in one retrospective cohort; authors limit use to screening support, not diagnosis.
evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
evidence.ai_role: An artificial neural network classifies malignant and non-malignant cases from routine cell-population data.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
